arabic text: ZAKHM DIL KE DIKHAWU ME KAISE, TERA LASHA UTHAWU ME KAISE
english translation text: HOW DO I SHOW YOU THE WOUNDS IN MY HEART, HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY?

arabic text: LAASHAY AKBAR PE SHAH JAB POHNCHAY DIL KO HAATHON SEH THAAM KAR BOLAY\nTERI FURQAT NAY AY ALI AKBAR AAG DIL MAIN MERAY LAGADI HAI\nAAG DIL KI BUJHAOON MAIN KAISAY TERA LAASHA UTAOON MAIN KAISAY
english translation text:
WHEN IMAM REACHED THE BODY OF AKBAR, HE BRACED HIMSELF AND SAID
YOUR SEPARATION HAS BROKEN MY HEART, AND IS BURNING MY HEART
HOW DO I STOP THESE FLAMES IN MY HEART?
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY

arabic text: TU HAI KARIYAL JAWAAN AY BETA BAAP TERA ZAEEF HAI KITNA\nNOOR ANKHON KA HOGAYA RUKHSAT MUJH KO ATA NAHIN NAZAR KHAIMA\nLAIKAY KHAIMON MAI JAOON MAI KAISAY TERA LAASHA UTAOON MAIN KAISAY.
english translation text:
O’ SON, YOU ARE A YOUNG MAN, AND YOUR FATHER IS AGED
I HAVE LOST MY VISION, I CANNOT SEE THE TENTS
HOW DO I TAKE YOU TO THE TENTS
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY

arabic text: JIS NEH ATHARA SAAL PALA THA KAISAY DEKHEGI WOH TERA LAASHA\nTERI SHAADI KA THA JISAY ARMAAN KAISAY JHELAYGI VO TERA SADMA\nTERI MAA KO BATAOON MAIN KAISAY TERA LAASHA UTAOON MAIN KAISAY.
english translation text:
THE ONE WHO BROUGHT YOU UP FOR 18 YEARS, HOW WILL SHE BEAR TO SEE YOUR BODY
THE ONE WHO HAD HOPES FOR YOU, HOW WILL SHE HANDLE THIS NEWS
HOW DO I TELL YOUR MOTHER
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY

arabic text: BHAYI BHENO KA HAI AJAB RISHTA JISKA SAANI KAHIN NAHIN MILTA\nROKAY SUGHRA NEY YE LIKHA AKBAR AIK DUKHIYA KI LAAJ RAKH LAYNA\nMAR GAYA TU BATAOON MAIN KAISAY TERA LAASHA UTAOON MAIN KAISAY.
english translation text:
A BROTHER AND SISTER HAVE A VERY UNIQUE RELATIONSHIP
SUGHRA CRIED AND SAID, LOOK OUT FOR HER
HOW DO I TELL SUGHRA THAT YOU HAVE DIED
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY

arabic text: AYSI GURBAAT PEH MOOU NAHIN MORRO MAI HUN TANHA MUJHE NA YOUN CHORO\nKYA GUZARTI HAI BAAP KAY DIL PAR GHUM ZADA DIL KO YOUN NAHI TORO\nAPNI GURBAAT BATAOON MAI KAISAY TERA LAASHA UTAOON MAIN KAISAY.
english translation text:
DON’T LEAVE ME IN THIS STRANGE PLACE, DON’T LEAVE ME ALONE
YOUR FATHER IS GOING THROUGH A LOT, DON’T BREAK MY HEART
HOW DO I TELL YOU MY FEELINGS
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY

arabic text: JAB KAHAA TUNE BABA ADRIKNI TAB SE EK PAL NA CHAIN PAYA HOON\nTERE LAASHE TALAK ALI AKBER CHALKE GHUTNO KE BAL ME AYAA HOON\nBETA KHUD KO UTHAUN ME KAISE
english translation text:
WHEN YOU CALLED OUT TO YOUR FATHER, I HAVE BEEN RESTLESS SINCE
TO YOUR BODY AKBAR, I HAVE COME ON MY KNEES
HOW DO I CARRY MYSELF NOW
HOW DO I CARRY YOUR BODY?
